text:
Ivan Barbashev's Vegas season will never headline a fantasy column, and that's fine. He has 5 goals and 17 points in 26 games, right in line with our talent range, and he does the things that make Vegas's top lines work: 53 hits, a forecheck, and pucks to the net front.

The best number is the shot share. Vegas controls 58% of the expected goals (chance quality) at five on five with him on, nearly eight points better than without him. Evolving-Hockey liked him even more last season, at 2.2 wins above replacement, though it also noted that he plays with strong teammates, which flatters raw on-ice numbers. He draws more penalties than he takes, worth 2.3 goals by their count.

His ice time has slipped, around 14 minutes a night lately, and only 3 of his points have come on the power play, so the counting stats will stay modest. He tied the game late against Winnipeg on Nov. 21 before Vegas won the shootout.

A two-time Cup winner (St. Louis in 2019, Vegas in 2023) doing exactly the job he always has.
headline: Barbashev does the dirty work, and it works
